blocks.text: Anasir ko families, mushtarak khusoosiyat wale anasir ke sets, se bhi baanta ja sakta hai. Mashhoor families alkali metals (Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs, Fr), alkaline earth metals (Be, Mg, Ca, Ba, Ra), transition metals (Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn), chalcogens (O, S, Se, Te, Po), halogens (F, Cl, Br, I, At, Ts) aur noble gases (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn, Og) hain.

items: Alkali metals: group 1 ke anasir, jo pani se react kar ke alkalis banate hain, is liye yeh naam; sodium aur potassium numayan misalein hain. In mein ek valence electron, kam kasafat (density), nisbatan kam melting point aur kam ionization energy hoti hai, aur yeh sab se zyada reactive metals hain.

Alkaline earth metals: group 2 ke metals, jo bunyadi taur par zameen mein milte aur alkalis banate hain, is liye yeh naam; calcium aur magnesium misalein hain. In ke valence shell mein do electrons hain, to yeh divalent hain; yeh dhaati thos hain, alkali metals se sakht aur ghane, asani se oxidise hote hain, aur un ki hararati aur barqi conductivity zyada hai.

Transition elements: sab se bari family, table ke darmiyan mein. In mein d block anasir ki chaar series aur neeche ki do qataron ke lanthanides aur actinides (f block) shamil hain. Yeh zyada hararati aur barqi conductivity, zyada melting points, zyada kasafat aur mukhtalif (variable) oxidation states dikhate hain, aur zyada tar rangdar compounds banate hain.

Chalcogens: group 16 ke anasir, jin ka naam is liye para ke tanbe (Greek chalkos) ki zyada tar kachi dhaatein (ores) oxides ya sulfides hain. Oxygen aur sulfur non-metals hain, Se, Te aur Po metalloids, aur livermorium ek metal.

Halogens: group 17 ke non-metals. Naam ka matlab namak-saz (salt-former) hai, kyunke yeh alkali aur alkaline earth metals se asani se react kar ke mustahkam halide namak banate hain; fluorine, chlorine aur bromine misalein hain. Yeh bohat reactive hain, zyada electron affinity rakhte hain, aur apna bairooni shell mukammal karne ke liye asani se ek electron qabool karte hain.

Noble gases: group 18 ke ghair-reactive anasir, table ke bilkul daen; helium aur argon misalein hain. Apne mustahkam, mukammal bairooni shell ki wajah se yeh mamool ke halaat mein taqreeban poori tarah ghair-reactive hain, shaz-o-nadir compounds banate hain, aur monoatomic hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Agarche noble gases ghair-reactive hain, un ke kuch compounds hain. Ek misal xenon ka compound, xenon hexafluoroplatinate (XePtF6), hai; aise compounds ki wajah se inert gases ka naam badal kar noble gases rakha gaya.

blocks.prompt: Groups 1 aur 2 ke anasir s block anasir kyun kehlate hain, aur kaun si family ka naam tanbe ki ores par hai?
blocks.explanation: Groups 1 aur 2 ke valence electrons s subshell mein hain, group 1 ke liye ek aur group 2 ke liye do, is liye yeh s block hain. Chalcogens, group 16, ka naam Greek chalkos se hai kyunke tanbe ki zyada tar ores in anasir ke oxides ya sulfides hain.

items: Chhe families: alkali metals (group 1, ek valence electron, sab se reactive metals), alkaline earth metals (group 2, divalent, sakht aur ghane), transition metals (d aur f blocks, variable oxidation states, rangdar compounds), chalcogens (group 16, tanbe ki ores), halogens (group 17, namak-saz, zyada electron affinity) aur noble gases (group 18, poore shells, monoatomic; xenon ke chand compounds).
